name: Lovin-Stein
source:
After a tragic death, you come back as a Frankenstein monster by a sweet, yet mad scientist. Face your second chance at life in this hilariously spooky adventure full of mystery, comedy and monster girls!

[From [url=https://lovin-stein.itch.io/lovin-stein]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
悲惨死亡后，你以弗兰肯斯坦怪物的身份被一位可爱但疯狂的科学家带回来。在这场充满神秘、喜剧和怪物女孩的搞笑怪异冒险中，迎接人生的第二次机会！

[来自[url=https://lovin-stein.itch.io/lovin-stein]itch.io[/url]]
